messages.subject: a new R-INLA book on dynamic time series
parts:
Dear INLA users,

This is an announcement regarding publication of a book on dynamic time series using R-INLA. The online version can be accessed from https://ramanbala.github.io/dynamic-time-series-models-R-INLA/ and a hard copy can be purchased from https://www.routledge.com/Dynamic-Time-Series-Models-using-R-INLA-An-Applied-Perspective/Ravishanker-Raman-Soyer/p/book/9780367654276.

Thanks,
